summary: Test-writing run only. Researched the real published OpenAPI spec (viamin/color_matching PR #113, closing #110) against docs/color-matching-api-contract.md, recorded concrete deltas in docs/color-matching-api-contract-deltas.md, and added two red-phase Swift tests pinning the two deltas that are expressible without touching implementation files. Full generated-client wiring (Package.swift deps, vendored spec, generated types, model replacement) is implementation work out of scope for this test-only phase and is not yet done.

acceptance_criteria.note: Adding swift-openapi-generator/runtime to Package.swift and vendoring the OpenAPI document is an implementation-file change, blocked by the test-writing-phase TDD boundary in this run. Pending the implementation run after paid-tests-approved.

Blocked on the same dependency/codegen wiring as AC-swift-openapi-dependency. docs/color-matching-api-contract-deltas.md records that the ranked-results surface currently has no client implementation at all (delta #3), which the implementation run needs to add.
Model replacement is implementation work; not permitted in this test-writing run.

Red-phase tests exercising stubbed/local responses against the current hand-written client, pinned to the real published API shape (not the prose doc). They fail today because SheetManifest drops capture_profile/printer_profile and the client's measurement-upload body includes a key the published schema doesn't declare -- exactly the drift issue #5 wants a generated client to catch at compile time instead. Could not run `swift test` in this environment (no Swift toolchain available in this Linux container); failures are derived from careful manual trace of SheetManifest's Codable implementation (Sources/MeasurementCore/Models.swift) and APIClient.uploadMeasurements (Sources/ColorMatchingLPSAppCore/APIClient.swift) against the fixtures in each test file. This is reported explicitly rather than inferred as a pass.

Deltas were derived from the actual merged viamin/color_matching PR #113 source (api_schemas.ex, api_spec.ex, router.ex, test_sheet_controller.ex, capture_controller.ex, test_sheet_json.ex at commit 05062f5381a6f76413cc2bdf1cb2cc08a1b70ff7), fetched live via GitHub's public API/raw content -- not guessed. Eight concrete deltas recorded, two of them pinned by the Swift tests above.
